question: Can retaining the full pretrained C38 representation, rather than only its numeric embeddings, unlock generalizable residual learning?
basis: C47/48 discarded C38 hidden layers and retrained residual backbones. C49 explicit transport helps high band but not low. C50 unsharing/fine-tuning all experts did not improve.
initialization: Frozen C38 complete encoder and8head predictions. Trainable384D fusion of hidden mean/std, branch prediction mean/std and294 normalized descriptors; zero residual output. Transport adds same directional quadrature asC49.
fairness: Both variants share parameter dictionary/initialization; same point order/seed/batch/loss/steps. Adapter bypasses transport nodes; effective active parameter count differs.
budget: Probe then12000updates each, common4096batch if memory permits otherwise2048; monitor1000; patience3000 after4000.
promotion: Both sampledDEV gain>=.10dB before fullDEV64; fullDEV64 jointgain>=.10 thenremaining548; officialVAL after allTRAIN refit.
scope_limit: No officialVAL training/selection; frozen parent dropout disabled in explicit feature extraction.
batch_choice: Common2048. Transport measured~65.4kpoints/s at2048 vs43.8k at4096; choose the faster exposure rate and smaller temporary memory. Adapter also uses2048 for identical sampling/update budget.
actual_main: adapter onphysical1 and transport onphysical3,12000updates each,2048batch.
